## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Abhidhammāvatāra-purāṇaṭīkā* is an early Pali subcommentary (*ṭīkā*) on Buddhadatta's fifth-century treatise, the *Abhidhammāvatāra* [Nyanatusita 2008]. It is situated within the Abhidhamma subcommentarial collection (*Tīkā-Abhidhamma*) and is attributed to either Vācissara Mahāsāmi or Sāriputta, dating to approximately the twelfth century [Nyanatusita 2008]. In secondary comparative literature, the text is referenced in connection with the exposition of the five universal orders or laws (*pañca-niyāmā*): physical order (*utu-niyāma*), biological order (*bīja-niyāma*), moral order (*kamma-niyāma*), psychological order (*citta-niyāma*), and natural or phenomenological order (*dhamma-niyāma*) [eJournal of Buddhist Research Studies 2015].

Textual analysis conducted by DharmaNexus indicates extensive Pali-internal text reuse, recording 75,446 matching segments across 492 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. In addition to extensive overlap with its base text, the *Abhidhammāvatāro* (such as segment range §405_5–418 aligning with §1000–1031), the largest text-sharing partners include the *Visuddhimagga-mahāṭīkā*, the *Dhammasaṅgaṇi-aṭṭhakathā* (*Atthasālinī*), the *Abhidhammatthasaṅgaho*, the *Visuddhimagga*, the *Paṭisambhidāmagga-aṭṭhakathā*, and the *Vibhaṅga-mūlaṭīkā* [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language alignments with Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora meet the match threshold [DharmaNexus].

**Parallels and text reuse**

- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Visuddhimagga-mahāṭīkā (Dutiyo bhāgo) (Anya E0104n) (§1972_0–1975_12 ↔ §988_0–992_8); Dhammasaṅgaṇi-aṭṭhakathā (Atk Abh01a) (§1298_0–1298_19 ↔ §1270–1275_2); Abhidhammatthasaṅgaho (Tika Abh07t) (§1694_22–1699_2 ↔ §1371_9–1375_2); Visuddhimaggo (Dutiyo bhāgo) (Anya E0102n) (§2431_9–2433_2 ↔ §1592_5–1598_2); Abhidhammāvatāro (Tika Abh06t) (§405_5–418 ↔ §1000–1031); Paṭisambhidāmagga-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0517a) (§1740_0–1740_11 ↔ §472–479); Visuddhimagga-mahāṭīkā (Paṭhamo bhāgo) (Anya E0103n) (§1308_0–1308_15 ↔ §526_0–526_12); Abhidhammamātikāpāḷi (Tika Abh09t) (§1115_7–1116_7 ↔ §1368_1–1368_7)
